messages.author: 23eee65194c38a7c
messages.subject: Attributes
parts:
Could anyone tell me why `set_attribute()` isn't working here?

```
lambda <- 3
mu <- 4

m.queue <- trajectory() %>%
  set_attribute("movie", function() sample(3, 1)) %>%
  seize("server", amount=1) %>%
  timeout(function() rexp(1, mu)) %>%
  release("server", amount=1)

mm23.env <- simmer() %>%
  add_resource("server", capacity=2, queue_size=1) %>%
  add_generator("arrival", m.queue, function() rexp(1, lambda)) %>%
  run(until=2000)

get_mon_attributes(mm23.env)
```

messages.author: 23eee65194c38a7c
messages.subject: Re: Attributes
parts: nvm. I just needed to enable it in "add_generator".

be enabled for each generator separately.
